groups.title: A　真的可能，還是只是想像

items.q: If the test ______ tomorrow, we will ship on Friday.（真的在排程）
If the price ______ lower, we would order more.（現在價格不低）
items.note: 假設現在 → 過去式，be 用 were。

items.q: If the PO had come earlier, we ______ last week.
items.note: 對過去的假設 → would have + V-ed。

items.q: ______ we get the drawing today, we can't start.
If I ______ you, I would accept the offer.
items.note: 固定句 If I were you。

items.q: If we had ordered more copper last month, we ______ short now.
items.note: 混合型：過去的 if，現在的結果。

items.q: I wish we ______ it earlier.（過去沒測）
items.note: wish + 過去完成 = 過去沒有。

items.q: Please keep a backup ______ the file gets corrupted.
We suggest that the customer ______ a thicker jacket.
______ you have any questions, please contact me.
如果你們訂 1 萬條，我們給 5% 折扣。（真的在報價）
items.a: If you order 10,000 pcs, we will give you a 5% discount.

items.q: 如果數量能再多一點，我們可以給更好的價格。（談判，講軟一點）
items.a: If you could increase the quantity, we could offer a better price.

items.q: 如果我們當初有測第一批，就會抓到那個瑕疵了。
items.a: If we had tested the first batch, we would have caught the defect.

items.q: 我們星期五前需要 PO，否則時程會延。
items.a: We need the PO by Friday; otherwise, the schedule will slip.

items.q: 真希望我們有多一點時間。
items.a: I wish we had more time.
